human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Review found that normalize_external_evidence_event unconditionally replaces normalized metadata with the inner wrapper metadata or {}, which erases producer-supplied outer metadata when the inner wrapper omits metadata. This directly defeats the existing artifact-reference preservation path: an outer metadata.artifact can disappear before _event_evidence_ref sees it. Repair only the proven erasure case. Preserve current behavior when inner metadata is a dict; when inner metadata is absent/non-dict, retain valid outer metadata. Do not invent a general metadata merge policy.
human_pressure.why_now: Commit 737e1f2 explicitly preserves export artifact references, but the external_evidence normalization path can still erase those references. Evidence normalization must not destroy provenance already present in the source envelope.
do_not_misread: Do not recursively merge arbitrary nested metadata.
Do not dereference, validate, fetch or materialize artifact URIs.
Do not change payload, event_type, scope_ref or event_id semantics.
Do not add producer-specific metadata rules.
red_lines: If inner metadata is absent/non-dict and outer metadata is a dict, normalized metadata must preserve the outer dict.
If inner metadata is a dict, preserve the existing inner-metadata precedence behavior in this pack.
No synthetic artifact/pointer values may be created.

machine_core.goal: Stop external_evidence normalization from erasing valid envelope metadata, so existing artifact/pointer provenance survives normalization without expanding metadata semantics.
invariants: Outer metadata survives when the valid inner wrapper has no dict metadata.
Existing inner dict metadata retains precedence and is not merged with outer metadata in this MVP.
Artifact/pointer extraction remains the responsibility of the existing EvidenceRef path.

producer.artifact: valid external_evidence wrapper with optional outer and inner metadata

observable_effect.assertion: A valid outer metadata.artifact or metadata.pointer remains visible after normalization when the inner wrapper does not supply a metadata dict; existing inner metadata precedence remains unchanged when it does.

proofs.assertion: Outer metadata containing artifact survives normalization when inner metadata is missing.
The preserved metadata reaches the existing EvidenceRef path so artifact is not lost.
When inner metadata is a dict, normalized metadata remains exactly that inner dict; no new merge semantics are introduced.
Invalid/non-dict outer metadata still does not produce fabricated metadata values.

failure_semantics: Absent inner metadata means fall back to already-present valid outer metadata, not {}.
Absent metadata on both layers remains empty/absent according to existing normalized output behavior.
This repair does not claim an artifact is valid or reachable; it only preserves the reference.

steps.title: Characterize metadata erasure
details: Add the exact review case: outer metadata.artifact on external_evidence, valid inner event/payload, no inner metadata.
Assert normalized metadata retains the artifact value.

steps.title: Repair only the fallback
details: When wrapper.metadata is a dict, keep current behavior.
Otherwise use event.metadata only when it is already a dict; do not merge the two dicts.

steps.title: Prove EvidenceRef preservation
details: Exercise the existing projection/reference path and prove the outer artifact reference remains observable after normalization.
Do not modify EvidenceRef semantics to make the test pass.

acceptance: Outer metadata.artifact survives a valid external_evidence wrapper with no inner metadata.
Outer metadata.pointer survives under the same fallback rule.
Inner dict metadata still wins exactly as before and is not recursively/implicitly merged.
No artifact URI is dereferenced or validated.
ruff, mypy, focused tests and the full pytest suite pass.

must_check: The exact review case preserves outer metadata.artifact through normalization.
The existing EvidenceRef path sees the preserved artifact without changes to artifact resolution semantics.
Inner dict metadata retains precedence; the implementation does not introduce a general merge policy.
Focused tests, full pytest, ruff and mypy pass.
reject_if: Outer valid metadata is still replaced by {} solely because inner metadata is missing.
The implementation recursively or generically merges arbitrary metadata.
Artifact references are fetched, validated or materialized.
Producer-specific branches or schema migrations are added.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Outer metadata fallback plus artifact-reference preservation without merge-policy expansion.
missing_targets: tests/test_external_evidence_metadata_preservation.py may be created by this pack
